channel.title: Emergency and critical care medicine
channel.description: Medical bulletin portal with the latest verified evidence across 20 specialties: vascular surgery, general surgery, OB/GYN, pediatrics, cardiology, internal medicine, neurology, oncology, orthopedics, urology, gastroenterology, nephrology, pulmonology, endocrinology, emergency medicine, infectious diseases, dermatology, psychiatry, rheumatology and plastic surgery. Full text and a short audio newscast for every issue.

item.title: Monthly emergency and critical care medicine bulletin — October 11, 2026
item.description: Period covered: September 29 to October 11, 2026 (13 days since the previous issue of September 28). It was a short period, light on large trials: the ESICM congress (LIVES 2026, Lisbon) begins its scientific sessions…

item.title: Monthly emergency medicine bulletin — September 28, 2026
item.description: Period covered: August 29 to September 28, 2026. It was a thin month for large trials in the specialty: seven items, each verified against its source. The most relevant news came from the European Society of Cardiology…
